title: AppSci-Bench: Can LLMs Build AI Agents and Make Them Better?
abstract: arXiv:2611.25360v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used not only to power AI agents but also to build them. While many benchmarks assess the quality of LLM- powered agents, few ascertain how good LLMs are at building them. To this end, we introduce AppSci-Bench, where we construct a setting akin to how human Applied Scientists build agents for businesses - through eliciting task requirements from stakeholders, exploring the business's infrastructure, and scientifically improve the target agent by designing experiments and internal benchmarks. AppSci-Bench features seven realistic domains - five new ones (Slides Generation, Order-to-Cash, Compliance Review, Customer Call Insights, and CRM Insights) and two domains recast from tau3-bench (Yao et al., 2024; Shi et al., 2026b)(Airline and Banking) - each with a held-out evaluation suite customized for that task. translated_title: AppSci-Bench：大语言模型能否构建AI智能体并使其变得更好？
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）不仅被越来越多地用于驱动AI智能体，还被用于构建它们。虽然已有许多基准测试用于评估LLM驱动的智能体的质量，但很少有基准测试能衡量LLM在构建智能体方面的能力。为此，我们推出了AppSci-Bench，该基准构建了一个类似于人类应用科学家为企业构建智能体的工作场景——通过从利益相关者那里获取任务需求、探索企业的基础设施，并通过设计实验和内部基准来科学地改进目标智能体。AppSci-Bench包含七个真实领域的任务——其中五个是新领域（幻灯片生成、订单到收款、合规审查、客户通话洞察和CRM洞察），另外两个是从tau3-bench（Yao等人，2024；Shi等人，2026b）重新改造而来的领域（航空和银行）——每个领域都配有针对该任务定制的保留评估套件。我们评估了七个前沿模型，发现AppSci-Bench极具挑战性：表现最好的模型……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出AppSci-Bench基准，用于评估大语言模型像人类应用科学家一样从需求出发构建并科学改进AI智能体的能力，实验表明该任务对当前最前沿的模型仍极具挑战性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces AppSci-Bench, a benchmark that evaluates LLMs' ability to build and scientifically improve AI agents the way human applied scientists do, and shows that this task remains highly challenging even for frontier models.
